summary: Spider Daedra are Daedric creatures that resemble a cross between a spider and a woman. They attack using a combination of ranged and melee abilities. They are usually found in the service of Mephala. Spider Daedra come in three variants: A black-shelled model, a red-shelled model, and a model with a non-humanoid face.
